eventMetadata.context_description: Houston Cougars' overwhelming favoritism at 97.2% implied probability stems from the stark competitive gulf, with the FBS Big 12 powerhouse facing an FCS Big Sky underdog in Idaho Vandals, where historical precedents show FBS teams winning over 95% of such matchups by wide margins. No major injuries or suspensions mar Houston's depth chart per official reports, and their home-field edge at TDECU Stadium amplifies rest advantages after offseason prep. Recent Vandals form shows modest success against peers but struggles versus superior athleticism. Realistic upset paths remain slim—catastrophic Houston turnovers, key starter injuries, or uncharacteristic offensive flops—but trader consensus reflects near-certainty in a rout.
